commits.subject: Box the config reload future for persistent MCP tool approvals (#62337)
commits.reason: Reduce the ordinary MCP call future's stack footprint while preserving the saved approval and its configuration scope.
evidence: In maybe_persist_mcp_tool_approval the connector and non-app writes still use the requesting turn's config. A failed write returns before reload. Only the successful path heap-pins and awaits the same reload_user_config_layer call.
The merged Rust patch on 6dd029d1a4 matches upstream. The existing project-scoped, plugin-default and session reload test cases exercise the affected persistence branches.
commits.revisit: Exercise persisted connector and project-local approvals, subsequent calls and plugin activation in the merged native build.
